analyzed_vuln.description: ReadPSInfo treats the bounded MagickByteBuffer payload as a NUL-terminated C string. When it recognizes the PostScript level marker, it calls GetMagickByteBufferDatum(&buffer)+4 and passes that pointer as the value of "ps:Level" to SetImageProperty. GetMagickByteBufferDatum compacts/refills the fixed 8192-byte stack buffer but does not append a NUL terminator. SetImageProperty consequently calls ConstantString(value), whose strlen reads beyond buffer.data, causing the stack-buffer-overflow. The caller must bound/terminate the extracted level value rather than passing the raw byte-buffer tail as a string.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A blob must be recognized and dispatched as PS/EPS, then ReadPSInfo must encounter a document-structuring scan position introduced by '%', newline, or carriage return where the following buffered bytes begin with "!PS-". The remaining attacker-controlled blob must refill MagickByteBuffer.data through its 8192-byte extent without an intervening NUL byte (as in the PoV's long nonzero tail). GetMagickByteBufferDatum then returns an unterminated stack-buffer view; after the +4 marker skip, that view flows through SetImageProperty to ConstantString/strlen and is read past the end of the stack buffer.
